meta.name: Math Formulas Dataset
meta.description: Machine-readable math formulas with LaTeX, variables, computable expressions and verified worked examples.

formulas.name: Binomial Coefficient
formulas.description: Number of ways to choose k items from n; also the coefficients in a binomial expansion.

formulas.name: Binomial Theorem (General Term)
formulas.description: Expands a binomial power; the term with index k is C(n, k)·aⁿ⁻ᵏ·bᵏ.

formulas.name: Modulus of a Complex Number
formulas.description: Distance of a + bi from the origin in the complex plane.

formulas.name: Focal Distance of a Hyperbola
formulas.description: Distance c from the center to each focus of a hyperbola.

formulas.name: Focal Distance of an Ellipse
formulas.description: Distance c from the center to each focus of an ellipse with semi-major axis a and semi-minor axis b.

formulas.name: Standard Equation of a Circle
formulas.description: All points (x, y) at distance r from the center (h, k). Given a point on the circle, r = √((x − h)² + (y − k)²).

variables.name: x of a point on the circle
y of a point on the circle

formulas.name: Distance Formula
formulas.description: Straight-line distance between two points in the plane.

formulas.name: Midpoint Formula
formulas.description: The point exactly halfway between two points.

formulas.name: Compound Interest
formulas.description: Balance after t years when interest at annual rate r is compounded n times per year.

formulas.name: Continuous Compound Interest
formulas.description: Balance when interest is compounded continuously, the limit of compound interest as n → ∞.

formulas.name: Exponential Growth and Decay
formulas.description: Amount after t periods when a quantity changes by a fixed percentage r each period (r < 0 for decay).

formulas.name: Half-Life Decay
formulas.description: Amount remaining after time t for a substance with half-life T.

formulas.name: Logistic Growth Model
formulas.description: Growth that starts out exponential and levels off at the carrying capacity K.

examples.note: At t = ln(9)/r the population reaches K/2.

formulas.name: Negative Exponent Rule
formulas.description: A negative exponent means the reciprocal of the positive power.

formulas.name: Power of a Power Rule
formulas.description: Raising a power to a power multiplies the exponents.

formulas.name: Product Rule for Exponents
formulas.description: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents.

formulas.name: Quotient Rule for Exponents
formulas.description: When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents.

formulas.name: Rational Exponent Rule
formulas.description: The denominator of a fractional exponent is a root; the numerator is a power.

formulas.name: Average Rate of Change
formulas.description: Slope of the secant line of f between x = a and x = b.

formulas.name: Difference Quotient
formulas.description: Average rate of change over [x, x + h]; its limit as h → 0 is the derivative.

formulas.name: Point-Slope Form
formulas.description: Equation of a line through the point (x₁, y₁) with slope m.

formulas.name: Slope Formula
formulas.description: Rise over run between two points on a line.
conditions: x₁ ≠ x₂ (vertical lines have undefined slope)

formulas.name: Slope of a Perpendicular Line
formulas.description: Perpendicular lines have slopes that are negative reciprocals (m₁·m₂ = −1).
conditions: m₁ ≠ 0 (perpendicular to a horizontal line is vertical)

formulas.name: Slope-Intercept Form
formulas.description: Equation of a line with slope m and y-intercept b.

formulas.name: Standard Form of a Line
formulas.description: General linear equation; solving for y gives y = (C − Ax) / B.

formulas.name: Change of Base Formula
formulas.description: Rewrites a logarithm in any base using a base your calculator has (usually 10 or e).

formulas.name: Definition of a Logarithm
formulas.description: A logarithm is the exponent you raise the base b to in order to get x.

formulas.name: Power Rule for Logarithms
formulas.description: An exponent inside a log can be moved out front as a multiplier.

formulas.name: Product Rule for Logarithms
formulas.description: The log of a product is the sum of the logs.

formulas.name: Quotient Rule for Logarithms
formulas.description: The log of a quotient is the difference of the logs.

formulas.name: Richter Scale Magnitude
formulas.description: Earthquake magnitude from the measured amplitude A compared with a reference amplitude A₀.

formulas.name: Determinant of a 2×2 Matrix
formulas.latex: \det\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix} = ad - bc
formulas.description: A 2×2 matrix is invertible exactly when its determinant is non-zero.

formulas.name: Vertex / Axis of Symmetry of a Parabola
formulas.description: The x-coordinate of the vertex of y = ax² + bx + c, which is also the axis of symmetry x = h.

examples.note: y = 2x² − 8x + 1 has axis of symmetry x = 2.

formulas.name: Vertex Form of a Quadratic
formulas.description: Writes a quadratic so the vertex (h, k) can be read off directly.

formulas.name: Completing the Square
formulas.description: The constant (b/2)² turns x² + bx into a perfect square trinomial.
conditions: Leading coefficient must be 1 (divide through first if not)

formulas.name: Discriminant of a Quadratic
formulas.description: Tells you how many real roots a quadratic has: two if Δ > 0, one if Δ = 0, none if Δ < 0.

examples.note: Positive, so two distinct real roots.

formulas.name: Quadratic Formula
formulas.description: Gives both solutions of any quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0.

formulas.name: Sum and Product of Quadratic Roots (Vieta)
formulas.description: Relates the roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 to its coefficients without solving the equation.

formulas.name: Arithmetic Sequence nth Term
formulas.description: Any term of a sequence that changes by a constant difference d.

formulas.name: Arithmetic Series Sum
formulas.description: Sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic sequence.

formulas.name: Finite Geometric Series Sum
formulas.description: Sum of the first n terms of a geometric sequence.

formulas.name: Geometric Sequence nth Term
formulas.description: Any term of a sequence that is multiplied by a constant ratio r each step.

formulas.name: Infinite Geometric Series Sum
formulas.description: Sum of all terms of a geometric series that converges.

formulas.name: Sum of the First n Positive Integers
formulas.description: Closed form for adding the integers from 1 to n.

formulas.name: Sum of the First n Squares
formulas.description: Closed form for adding the squares from 1² to n².

formulas.name: Cramer's Rule (2×2 System)
formulas.plain: x = (c₁b₂ − b₁c₂)/D,  y = (a₁c₂ − c₁a₂)/D,  D = a₁b₂ − b₁a₂
formulas.description: Solves a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂ using determinants.

formulas.name: Direct Variation
formulas.description: y varies directly with x: doubling x doubles y.

formulas.name: Inverse Variation
formulas.description: y varies inversely with x: doubling x halves y.

formulas.name: Joint Variation
formulas.description: z varies directly with the product of x and y.

formulas.name: Combined Work Rate
formulas.description: Time t for two workers together when they take t₁ and t₂ alone; equivalently t = t₁t₂ / (t₁ + t₂).

formulas.name: Distance = Rate × Time
formulas.description: Distance traveled at a constant rate r for time t.
conditions: Units of r and t must match (e.g. km/h and hours)

formulas.name: Mixture Concentration
formulas.description: Concentration of a mixture made from two solutions.
